experience.title: Data & Technology Consultant
experience.orgDescriptor: Premium hot chocolate brand, 30+ UK stores plus UAE
experience.summary: Owned the Power BI report layer at Knoops. Estate audit, data quality incident response, SaaS capability assessment and C-suite advisory.
bullets: Owned the Power BI report layer for a premium hot chocolate brand scaling across 30+ UK stores plus the UAE. Ran a full estate audit; the flagship Weekly Scorecard alone carried 50+ tables and 600+ measures.

Led incident response when a Shopify store migration loaded several hundred historical UAE orders into the UK store with incorrect dates and an unconverted currency. Root caused it, ruled out three lookalike pipeline symptoms and specified the resolution.

Reconciled Weekly Scorecard metrics against Tenzo. Isolated defects including material duplication in Arch app order data, unmapped fact rows traced to a stale SharePoint product hierarchy and a timezone day shift that reproduced only in the Power BI Service.

Assessed the commercial SaaS stack (Klaviyo, Shopify, Revel, Arch, Katana, MarketMan) against actual usage. Klaviyo was running at under a quarter of its licensed capability, a five figure revenue opportunity from features already paid for.
Built a four phase roadmap to reduce dependency on Ardeema, the external agency holding the pipeline and semantic model. Reported to and briefed C-suite including the CEO and CFO.
experience.publishingNote: Company names are cleared for publication. Figures stay rounded (as-reported, never audited). Do not publish individuals' names, and do not claim ownership of the pipeline or semantic model, which were Ardeema's.

Ran weekly and monthly reviews; shipped executive dashboards for planning and supply decisions.

Added CV quality gates (de-skew, resolution checks), reducing re-submissions and improving first-time-right.
